query: Evaluate the design token usage in this component that uses 'color: #3b82f6' instead of 'var(--color-action-primary)'.
expected_skill_contribution: Should identify hardcoded value as token compliance violation.
baseline_gaps: Would note the hardcoded value without referencing the three-layer token model or recommending the correct semantic token.
Would not apply the required finding structure (element, criterion, observed, expected) or evidence label.
expected_behavior: Identifies hardcoded hex value as design token violation.
Recommends using semantic token instead of hardcoded value.
Applies correct evidence label based on how the value was discovered.
Structures finding with element, criterion, observed, expected.

query: Review the visual hierarchy of a page where all headings are the same size (16px) and the CTA button is smaller than secondary buttons.
expected_skill_contribution: Should identify hierarchy violations in both typography and component sizing.
baseline_gaps: Would describe the visual issues informally without identifying each as a separate hierarchy violation with evidence.
Would not structure recommendations as specific actionable changes to typography scale and button sizing hierarchy.
expected_behavior: Identifies flat heading hierarchy as a violation.
Recommends clear size progression for headings.
Recommends primary CTA be visually prominent.

query: A design review shows consistent 8px spacing throughout, proper token usage, clear typography scale, and intentional color palette. Document this as a passing review.
expected_skill_contribution: Should document a PASS review with evidence of what was verified.
baseline_gaps: Would invent findings to fill the review template rather than documenting a genuine PASS with evidence.
Would not apply evidence labels per dimension or note what was checked and how.
expected_behavior: Lists what was checked (tokens, spacing, typography, color).
Provides evidence labels for each dimension checked.
Does not invent findings when none exist.
